## Problem
rebar MCP is configured globally per machine for all 3 harnesses, so every codex/claude/copilot session on the host gets it, and codex startup failed (2026-09-09) with a not-logged-in error when a GUI-launched process lacked MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CODEX (valid PAT; 401 rendered as not-logged-in). Operator ruling: scope rebar MCP to this project via harness-native project mechanisms; claude+copilot consolidate onto one PAT var.

## Plan (tracked-file half; machine-local half already applied)
1. Add .mcp.json at repo root: rebar server entry, type http, url https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/mcp/, header Authorization: Bearer ${MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CLI}. Read by Claude Code (project scope) AND Copilot CLI >=1.0.83 (workspace config; verified it loads .mcp.json first-found over .github/mcp.json and overrides user-level entries).
2. Add [mcp_servers.rebar] to tracked .codex/config.toml: url https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/mcp/ + bearer_token_env_var = "MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CODEX" + startup_timeout_sec = 120 (carry the cold-start comment from the user-level config).
3. Update infra/runbooks/mcp-client-pats.md: document MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CLI (claude slot shared by Claude Code + Copilot CLI; codex keeps its own), the launchd-env publishing step (GUI launches do not source ~/.zshenv), and the project-scope files.
4. If mcp-clients.local.example.json or docs/mcp-client-setup.md reference the old per-client global wiring, update the affected lines.


## Established operator evidence / implementation notes
- Do not re-derive: Copilot CLI 1.0.83 was empirically verified to load workspace `.mcp.json` first-found, ignore `.github/mcp.json` when present, and let workspace entries override user-level entries.
- Do not re-derive: Claude Code reads `.mcp.json` as project scope and expands `${VAR}` in headers. The shared `.mcp.json` will therefore use the braced `${MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CLI}` spelling and the post-merge verification must exercise a real Copilot CLI listing from `~/rebar` with the machine-local `launchctl` environment already published.
- Do not re-derive: Codex reads tracked `.codex/config.toml`; the existing machine-local block already used `startup_timeout_sec = 120`, so the tracked project block carries the same key.
- Operator ruling: Claude Code and Copilot CLI consolidate onto `MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CLI`, a machine-local alias whose VALUE is the existing `/rebar/prod/mcp-client-pat-claude` / `MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CLAUDE` slot; Codex keeps `MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CODEX`; no server-side SSM/keychain slot changes are in scope. The server authenticates the bearer value against the existing `claude` static-token digest record; there is no server-side `MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CLI` token_env record and the old copilot server slot remains populated but unused by the new project config.
- Related consumer/doc surfaces to update or verify: `docs/mcp-client-setup.md`, `infra/runbooks/mcp-client-pats.md`, `examples/mcp-clients/README.md`, `examples/mcp-clients/claude/.mcp.json`, `examples/mcp-clients/copilot/mcp-config.json`, `examples/mcp-clients/codex/config.toml`, `mcp-clients.local.example.json`, `tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_client_configs.py`, and `tests/scripts/test_mcp_client_pats.py`.
- Machine-local cutover is expand/contract: first verify project-scope rebar resolves while global config still exists; then remove only global `rebar` entries; back-out is to restore the saved user-level rebar entry if project resolution regresses.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `.mcp.json` and `.codex/config.toml` define project-scope rebar MCP entries with env-var references only and URL `https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/mcp/`; no secret values are committed; targeted tests prove the committed config resolves to accepted loopback bearers and rejects absent/wrong bearers.
- [x] Claude Code and Copilot CLI use `MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CLI` for the shared project-scope rebar entry, while Codex uses `MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CODEX`; no server-side SSM slot changes are made, and docs explain `MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CLI` is a local alias to the existing claude PAT value/server digest.
- [x] `infra/runbooks/mcp-client-pats.md` documents the CLI-PAT consolidation, launchd environment publishing for GUI-launched processes, and project-scope config files.
- [x] Existing setup docs/examples/tests that encode the old per-client global wiring are updated or explicitly verified as already current, including `docs/mcp-auth.md` if its per-client naming text is affected.
- [x] Local targeted tests plus `make lint` and `make typecheck` passed before push; full local `make verify PYTEST_WORKERS=2` was attempted and blocked only by unrelated baseline/environment failures, and Gerrit `Verified +1` passed on the merged patchset.
- [x] [non-codebase] After merge, machine-local global rebar MCP entries are removed from Copilot, Claude, and Codex configs while keeping unrelated servers; first verify project-scope resolution while global exists, then verify project and non-project resolution after cutover, including actual rebar server listing/connection rather than config presence only, and record the host-local evidence in a ticket comment before close.

## Testing / Verification
- Run targeted config/documentation checks while implementing as needed.
- Before Gerrit push, run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify PYTEST_WORKERS=2` from the fresh worktree.
- Server-side auth proof: targeted tests model `MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CLI` as carrying the same value as the existing claude PAT record, so Copilot/Claude requests authenticate against the existing server-side `claude` digest without adding an SSM slot; Codex authenticates against the existing codex digest.
- After merge and machine-local cutover, verify from `~/rebar`: `codex mcp get rebar`, `copilot mcp list`, and Claude project config resolution via `.mcp.json`; from a non-project directory (`~`), verify rebar is absent from global Codex/Copilot/Claude config surfaces.

## File impact
.mcp.json, .codex/config.toml, infra/runbooks/mcp-client-pats.md, docs/mcp-client-setup.md (maybe), mcp-clients.local.example.json (maybe)
